baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled k-f-r, followed by deeds, knowing, and the essence of chests.
baseline_models.mechanism: The act and possessed state of k-f-r form a cover over an interior source; intended deeds issue from that source, and return plus notification reverses concealment into accountable disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Literal covering supplies the concealed layer that the later account exposes.
Blocking truth specifies the moral form taken by the cover.
The chest as an origin from which acts issue locates the hidden source.
Purposive action is the outward product through which the source becomes accountable.
Return carries actors back to the point at which concealment can no longer defer account.
Consequentially delivered news converts the hidden deed into an announced account.
Unconcealed knowledge closes the circuit from hidden origin to disclosed result.

changed_reading.before: A denier will eventually be told what he did.
changed_reading.after: What is covered at the interior source becomes legible as intended action on return; notification is the reversal of concealment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative prohibition in fa-la yahzunka kufruhu.
baseline_models.mechanism: Another person's covering can roughen or abrade the addressee's inward state, but the prohibition interrupts that transfer; their return relocates the unresolved weight away from the addressee.

activation_trace.role: Grief as inward roughness names the affective effect that the prohibition blocks.
Heart-irritation sharpens the grief as an abrasion, while the split mapping keeps this image secondary.
The other person's truth-blocking is the external cause that must not become the addressee's interior condition.
Return to God transfers resolution out of the addressee's affective custody.

changed_reading.before: Do not feel sad when someone disbelieves.
changed_reading.after: Do not let another's act of covering migrate into and roughen your own interior; its unresolved account has another destination.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive kufruhu beside yahzunka and their return to Us.
baseline_models.mechanism: The dependent-liability branch of h-z-n makes the possessive exact: the disbelief remains his burden rather than becoming an account the addressee must carry as though for a dependent.

activation_trace.role: Household dependency and attached liability open a social-burden sense behind the grief verb.
The suffixed act remains the other person's own obstruction of truth.
Their own return supplies the destination of a nontransferable liability.

changed_reading.before: The addressee is comforted about a disappointing response.
changed_reading.after: The addressee is also released from proxy liability: his disbelief is his, and his return is not yours to carry.

baseline_models.mechanism: Return can be a returned answer as well as movement, while notification is news that arrives; the fa sequence makes the later encounter the venue of reply, reducing pressure for an immediate answer now.

activation_trace.role: A returned answer turns return into a deferred communicative reply.
Movement from place to place lets the report arrive with the returning subject.
Weighty delivered news supplies the content of that reply.
The blocked inward roughening is the practical consequence of deferring the reply.

changed_reading.before: Return and notification are two generic future events.
changed_reading.after: Return is the deferred venue where the unanswered refusal receives its reply, so grief need not force premature closure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier listener buys distracting speech, turns away, and performs nonhearing under an ear-weight. This makes the focus k-f-r an actively maintained reception barrier, while the grief prohibition addresses the pain of refused reception rather than mere absence of assent.

activation_trace.role: Covering anchors the focus reading as an obstruction rather than a bare label.
Inward roughness registers the cost of repeatedly encountering that obstruction.
Distraction by another thing supplies a deliberate diversion from the message.
Turning the back converts diversion into enacted refusal.
Hearing as understanding and compliance shows what the simulated deafness withholds.
Weight in the ear materializes the maintained reception barrier.

structural_cues: The 31:6-7 sequence runs from purchased diversion to turning away to feigned nonhearing before the focus prohibition addresses grief.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies diversion, turning, hearing, and ear-weight; I infer a manufactured cover that causes grief; alternatively these may be parallel signs of arrogance without a single causal sequence.

changed_reading.before: The focus responds to a static category called disbelief.
changed_reading.after: It responds to an enacted process that keeps truth from being received, and forbids that repeated refusal from colonizing the addressee's interior.

context_deltas.mechanism: The explicit gratitude/k-f-r contrast activates covering a benefit: gratitude returns benefit to the grateful self, whereas God's sufficiency prevents denial from diminishing its source. The focus possessive therefore marks a self-enclosed loss rather than damage the addressee must repair.

activation_trace.role: Covering a benefit supplies the gratitude-sensitive sense of the focus term.
Recognizing benefit and praising its giver establishes the live opposite of covering it.
The contextual occurrence directly places benefit-covering opposite repeated gratitude.
Self-sufficiency blocks the inference that the denial impoverishes God or transfers a deficit to the addressee.

structural_cues: The repeated man yashkur is reflexively bounded by li-nafsihi, then man kafara is answered by divine sufficiency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the contrast, reflexive benefit, and sufficiency; I infer that covered benefit rebounds on its human subject; alternatively k-f-r here may retain the broader truth-denial sense without a gratitude mechanism.

changed_reading.before: His disbelief is a loss that naturally burdens the addressee.
changed_reading.after: His covering of benefit is reflexively his deficit; it neither depletes the giver nor assigns the addressee a repair debt.

context_deltas.mechanism: Under parental pressure toward association without knowledge, obedience is refused but recognized-good companionship remains, immediately followed by the same return-report formula. The focus can therefore defer another's account to God without licensing coercion or relational abandonment.

activation_trace.role: Return anchors the focus transfer of final account.
Continuing companionship preserves relationship across principled noncompliance.
Recognized good constrains how disagreement is socially carried.
The exact contextual return formula relocates judgment after bounded companionship.
The ensuing delivered report reserves eventual disclosure to God.

structural_cues: In 31:15, fa-la tutihuma and wa-sahibhuma coexist before thumma ilaya marjiukum fa-unabbiukum.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nonobedience, good companionship, and return-report in sequence; I infer that divine account removes the need for coercive human closure; alternatively the social limit may apply specifically to parents.

changed_reading.before: Do not grieve because God will handle the rejecter later.
changed_reading.after: Entrust final account to God while maintaining ethically bounded relationship now; deferred judgment is a discipline of noncoercion, not disengagement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mustard-grain weight hidden inside solid rock gives a material test case for the focus circuit: even a minute action buried behind a hard cover can be brought out. Knowledge of chests becomes active retrieval, not passive omniscience.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the attempted concealment that the context tests.
The action-origin inside the chest anchors the hidden object back in the focus.
Measured weight makes even the smallest deed evidentially countable.
A germ-bearing grain supplies the minute material object of retrieval.
Massive solidity supplies the strongest local enclosure around that object.
Fineness and hidden smallness explain how retrieval reaches beneath scale and cover.

structural_cues: Nested fi phrases place the grain in rock, heavens, or earth before yati biha Allah reverses concealment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a tiny weighted grain, nested enclosure, and divine bringing; I infer an evidentiary surfacing mechanism for the focus deeds; alternatively 31:16 may illustrate omnipotence generally rather than accountability specifically.

changed_reading.after: The focus depicts a retrieval system in which scale, hardness, and enclosure cannot prevent a hidden microdeed from being brought into account.

context_deltas.mechanism: Complete benefits span exterior and interior, yet twisted dispute without knowledge is followed by inherited following. This creates a layered reading: public argument and ancestral script can cover an inner source even while benefits already envelop both visible and hidden life; chest-knowledge penetrates beneath the displayed script.

activation_trace.role: Covering anchors the layering of outward script over inward source.
The chest-origin distinguishes a deed's source from its public rationale.
Expansive coverage supplies the ironic envelope of benefits around the one who covers them.
Visible emergence marks the publicly inspectable layer.
Hidden interiority marks the layer reached by knowledge of chests.
Twisted dispute supplies a public verbal cover that can obscure its source.
Following behind another supplies the inherited rather than self-originating script.
Ancestral nurture identifies the social carrier of that script.

structural_cues: The apparent/hidden pair is followed by dispute without knowledge, then by the quoted appeal to what was found upon the fathers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enveloping benefits, exterior/interior layers, dispute, and ancestry; I infer that inherited public speech may cover the chest-origin of action; alternatively the ancestry passage may describe content without implying psychological layering.

changed_reading.before: God knows an individual's private belief behind a public denial.
changed_reading.after: God's account separates inherited and performed scripts from the interior source that adopts, resists, or instrumentalizes them; visible speech is not treated as the whole deed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, one releases the face toward God while holding a reliable grip, and all matters have an outcome there. The focus presents the competing orientation: covering may hide the chest, but both embodied trajectories terminate at the same destination.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the obstructed orientation contrasted with open surrender.
Return carries both orientations to their common destination.
Handing over and releasing supplies the open directional act opposite concealment.
Directionality turns surrender into a whole-person trajectory.
Active holding supplies the bodily mechanics of commitment.
Reliability explains why that grip can bear the trajectory.
The end of a process anticipates the focus return as outcome rather than mere transport.

structural_cues: The adjacent verses repeat ila Allah and move from aqibat al-umur to marjiuhum.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies surrender, directed face, grip, reliability, outcome, and return; I infer two embodied trajectories converging for account; alternatively 31:22 may describe only the faithful path without forming a mechanical contrast.

changed_reading.before: The focus tells the addressee to wait for an unrelated future return.
changed_reading.after: It completes an orientation pair: open surrender and covered refusal are different present trajectories whose outcome and return already point to God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next verse contracts pleasurable use into little duration, then changes voluntary motion into compulsion toward severity. The focus return is deferred but not indefinite; the grief prohibition corrects timescale rather than treating denial as consequence-free.

activation_trace.role: Return supplies the destination whose temporal shape the next verse specifies.
Enjoyed benefit supplies the apparently open present interval.
Smallness contracts that interval and prevents delay from looking final.
Necessity and compulsion convert delayed return into forced narrowing.
Intensified judgment gives the narrowing its juridical severity.

structural_cues: Qalilan is followed by thumma and the first-person plural nadtarruhum, immediately after marjiuhum.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies brief enjoyment, sequence, compulsion, and severity; I infer that 31:24 unfolds the mechanics of 31:23 return; alternatively it may specify punishment after, rather than the motion of, return.

changed_reading.before: Do not grieve because accountability exists at an unspecified later time.
changed_reading.after: Do not confuse a short interval of unopposed enjoyment with escape; return is a timed contraction from latitude into necessity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those questioned can correctly say that God created the heavens and earth while still being described as mostly not knowing. K-f-r in the focus can therefore be a split between uttered recognition and integrated knowledge/action, which only knowledge of chests can adjudicate.

activation_trace.role: Truth-obstruction allows acknowledgment to coexist with a blocked implication.
Unconcealed divine knowing is the standard against which the split is visible.
Questioning elicits the public proposition that can be compared with interior uptake.
Origination is the true content publicly conceded.
Spoken output marks acknowledgment at the exterior layer.
The contextual denial of knowing prevents correct speech from being equated with integrated recognition.

structural_cues: The expected answer Allah is immediately followed by praise and then bal aktharuhum la yalmun.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a correct spoken answer and a denial of knowing; I infer an integration gap between proposition, chest, and action; alternatively la yalmun may concern other facts rather than their own answer's implications.

changed_reading.before: The kafir simply lacks or rejects the relevant proposition.
changed_reading.after: The focus can address someone who voices a true proposition while covering its claims on orientation and action; chest-knowledge judges the integration gap.

context_deltas.mechanism: Inexhaustible words follow the finite image of seas extending ink, then creation and raising of all people collapse to one self. The focus notification is not divine information acquisition: it is finite deeds being authoritatively addressed within speech that does not run out, without plural scale diluting individual account.

activation_trace.role: Delivered consequential news anchors the act of individualized address.
Prior knowledge prevents notification from being read as discovery for God.
Vast water supplies the largest finite reservoir for the speech image.
Ink replenishing a pen supplies the material channel of unexhausted address.
Nontermination blocks any scarcity of words for complete account.
Meaningful speech connecting speakers supplies the communicative scale of notification.
Rousing the still supplies the transition into returned address.
Unity in one direction compresses the multitude without erasing each self.

structural_cues: The inexhaustible words image in 31:27 is immediately followed by all creation and resurrection being like one self in 31:28.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unending words, ink extension, raising, and one-self scale; I infer that informing manifests known finite deeds rather than filling a divine data gap; alternatively the two verses may make separate claims about knowledge and power.

changed_reading.before: God informs a crowd of facts after learning or collecting their deeds.
changed_reading.after: Already-known deeds are individually rendered in inexhaustible address; neither the multitude nor the report implies a limit in knowledge or speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: A wave physically covers like overhead canopies; danger strips devotion to an unmixed state, rescue separates the subjects onto land, and safety is followed by knowing denial, betrayal, and ingratitude. The focus k-f-r becomes dynamic re-covering after dependence has been exposed, so grief need not track each oscillation; return holds the entire sequence.

activation_trace.role: Covering anchors the focus term to the context's material and moral sequence.
Return provides a stable endpoint beyond the subjects' crisis-driven oscillation.
An overhead cover makes concealment physically present before the moral reversal.
Intermixed turbulence supplies the destabilizing pressure that exposes dependency.
An overhead canopy specifies the spatial shape of the cover.
Purification after mixture supplies the temporary uncovering of devotion.
Escape by separation moves the subjects out from under the material cover.
Denial despite knowledge marks the later state as re-covering rather than first ignorance.
Failure of fidelity makes post-rescue concealment relational betrayal.
Benefit-covering identifies the final kufur as ingratitude after rescue.

structural_cues: The sequence is cover, exclusive call, rescue, partial moderation, then denial by every betraying ingrate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies physical cover, purified crisis devotion, rescue, knowing denial, and ingratitude; I infer an uncovering then re-covering cycle; alternatively crisis devotion may be merely temporary rather than a consciously betrayed disclosure.

changed_reading.before: K-f-r is a stable identity that disappoints the addressee.
changed_reading.after: K-f-r can be the act of covering dependence again after crisis exposed it; the addressee is released from emotionally following that unstable cycle because the full trajectory returns to God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mirrored parent-child negations deny that either can stand in for the other. This activates the focus's possessive and the dependent-liability edge of h-z-n: even closest kinship cannot transfer his disbelief or its account onto another bearer.

activation_trace.role: Dependent liability supplies the exploratory burden that the later non-substitution rule limits.
Personal return gives the nontransferable account its destination.
The day's severe event supplies the setting in which ordinary bonds fail as surety.
One thing standing in place of another is explicitly negated for both directions of kinship.
Direct descent supplies the strongest available human claim for proxy bearing.
Ignorance of outcome explains why present closeness can be mistaken for transferable security.

structural_cues: Parent and child exchange grammatical positions under repeated negation, making non-substitution symmetrical.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal failed substitution and kinship; I infer that kufruhu remains nontransferably his and that grief must not become proxy liability; alternatively the h-z-n liability branch is form-near but not the primary grief sense.

changed_reading.before: The prohibition only regulates an emotion about another person.
changed_reading.after: It also refuses an imagined surety relation: neither prophetic concern nor family closeness can carry another subject's possessed account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing verse repeats that no self knows its next acquisition or place of death, then returns to divine knowing. Focus knowledge of chests thus spans motive, future output, and endpoint, while notification corrects the subject's inevitably partial self-account.

activation_trace.role: Unconcealed knowledge anchors the divine side of the asymmetry.
The source of action anchors the asymmetry in the subject's interior origin.
Delivered account supplies the correction of incomplete self-narration.
Repeated divine knowing extends disclosure across time, generation, and interiority.
Human knowing is explicitly bounded at future action and endpoint.
The self as the very identity of the subject makes the ignorance reflexive, not merely ignorance of others.
Future acquisition supplies an action whose result is not yet available to the acting self.
Loss of life supplies the unknown terminal location of the self's course.
Knowledge of an affair's interior makes divine knowing deeper than the subject's forecast.

structural_cues: Twice repeated wa-ma tadri nafsun is answered at the surah's close by inna Allaha alimun khabir.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reflexive human unknowns and repeated divine knowing; I infer that the focus report corrects deficient self-account across motive, deed, and end; alternatively the focus knowledge may be narrower, concerning present motives only.

changed_reading.before: God sees motives that other humans cannot see.
changed_reading.after: God knows the action-source and whole course that even the acting self cannot narrate in advance; the final report confronts the self with more than its own remembered story.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the farming branch is not the ordinary lexical rendering of k-f-r here. It remains anchored in the focus's covering term and deed-report circuit, and 31:16 supplies an actual grain under enclosure. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy of delayed emergence, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: K-f-r as covering, followed by deeds that are later brought into report.

activation_trace.role: Seed-covering supplies burial that can conceal while also setting up later emergence.
Intended deed is what the buried image analogically carries forward.
Delivered report supplies the later appearance of what had been buried.
A germ-bearing grain gives the remote focus branch a concrete contextual activator.

changed_reading.before: Covering only suppresses or hides truth.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the cover also resembles burial: a deed can disappear from view yet remain poised to emerge into report rather than cease to exist.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain because a celestial cycle is being mapped onto moral concealment and disclosure. It remains anchored by the focus branch in which darkness is a covering expanse, the focus return, and the contextual work/awareness clause. Downstream prose should label it a temporal-spatial analogy, not claim that k-f-r lexically means night.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The covering branch of k-f-r and marjiuhum as a directed return.

activation_trace.role: An engulfing dark cover licenses the limited analogy to night.
Return anchors the celestial motion back in the focus's directed course.
Mutual entry makes concealment and visibility interpenetrating phases rather than static compartments.
Night supplies the recurring field of darkness and cover.
Daylight opening supplies the recurring disclosure phase.
Continuous running turns the phases into an ordered course.
An appointed limit gives that course a nonnegotiable temporal endpoint.
The closing reference to deeds reconnects the cosmic course to the focus account.

changed_reading.before: Return interrupts concealment only once at a remote endpoint.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, concealment and disclosure already alternate within an appointed course, while deeds continue moving toward a final return that fixes their account.

strongest_changes: K-f-r shifted from a static identity to repeated covering, especially re-covering exposed dependence after rescue.
Return-report became a transfer of nonproxy liability that permits bounded companionship and removes pressure for coercive closure.
Knowledge of chests became active retrieval and correction of hidden microdeeds and incomplete self-knowledge, not generic omniscience.
The adjacent orientation, respite, crisis, kinship, and closing-knowledge sequences preserved several coexisting mechanisms rather than one final interpretation.
summary.what_was_special: Material cover, inward roughness, social liability, public script, bodily orientation, temporal course, and epistemic asymmetry all converged on the same focus constructions without collapsing into a single reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The buried-seed and night/day models are branch-licensed analogies, not lexical replacements for k-f-r.
The h-z-n to h-z-z heart-abrasion mapping and the dependent-liability branch remain form-distant or secondary.
The noncoercive social implication from 31:15 may be strongest in the parent-child setting rather than universally generalizable.
